name: date-recovery
title: Date Recovery
description: Recovers a usable date for assets that land on 1970-01-01 because the uploading client sent an empty capture date and the file carries no EXIF.
author: Francois Chaussin

methods.name: recoverEpochDate
methods.title: Recover epoch dates
methods.description: When an asset's date falls at or near the Unix epoch, replace it with the file's own modification date, which the client preserved.

thresholdYear.title: Broken before year
thresholdYear.description: Any asset dated before 1 January of this year is treated as broken. Photography predating this is not expected in a phone backup.

templates.name: recover-epoch-dates
templates.title: Recover 1970 dates
templates.description: Runs after metadata extraction and repairs assets dated 1970-01-01, using the date the file itself carries.
